verdict: Yes, for a team with drone expertise. Inside FPV from Surat pitched plug-and-fly drones on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. India's liberalised drone rules and government support have opened markets in agriculture, surveying and filmmaking.
angle: Drones are used for crop spraying, surveys, inspections and filming. The Drone Rules, 2021 and production incentives support Indian makers. Training pilots and servicing drones add revenue.
